validation: RC29.4 FIX5.2: detection automatique corrigee quand une session armee reste en attente pendant une plage deja active; FIX5.1 et FIX5 conserves.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.4 FIX5.2: le service Live relance systematiquement la reprise apres verification de l auto-armement et applique un watchdog cible apres 12 s si une session due reste anormalement dans connection_state=waiting.
V60.5 ARCH RC29.4 FIX5.2: le watchdog ne vole jamais un bail valide d un autre worker et ne redemarre pas les etats waiting_browser, qui conservent leur boucle de reconnexion Edge/Hermes existante.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.4 FIX5.1: Ouvrir la supervision Hermes ne considere plus le simple lancement du worker comme un succes; Edge/CDP et la presence d un onglet Hermes sont verifies et les erreurs sont remontees dans l interface.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.4 FIX5.1: un profil Edge Nelyio stale sans CDP peut etre redemarre automatiquement; seuls les processus msedge appartenant au user-data-dir TECH-IN\Nelyio\CaptureBrowser sont concernes, jamais les Edge utilisateur ordinaires.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.4 FIX5.1: Diagnostic Hermes expose Preparation, Verification Edge, Ouverture Edge, Attente Hermes, Analyse, Termine et Erreur; les boutons utilisent une delegation stable et le statut est rafraichi chaque seconde pendant une operation.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.4 FIX5.1: le lancement manuel du scanner effectue un preflight websockets et signale immediatement si aucun onglet Supervision n est disponible quand l option d ouverture est desactivee.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.4 FIX5: Incidents / Stat Live devient une analyse 90 jours: historique detaille, filtres Du/Au, totaux par agent, distribution par type et par jour; la capture Live operationnelle reste limitee a la journee courante.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.4 FIX5: Signalisation Qualite Live reste la source unique des niveaux/couleurs appliques aux lignes Agent; progression configurable Surveillance/Degrade/Critique, presets Post-appel, pauses, dejeuner, Coaching, General Break, HOLD, HOLD precoce, deconnexion et contexte inactif.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.4 FIX5: Diagnostic Hermes admin ajoute un scanner CDP passif manuel 30/60/120 s et une planification optionnelle OFF par defaut; XHR/Fetch/WebSocket sont analyses en memoire sans conserver corps bruts, cookies, headers, tokens ni identifiants.
V60.5 ARCH RC29.4 FIX5: diagnostic de couverture expose les files catalogue sans UpQuH/UpQuR afin d expliquer les ecarts Hermes/Nelyio avant toute modification de calcul.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.4 FIX5: ouverture supervision + auto-login Hermes optionnel via Windows DPAPI CurrentUser; secret jamais renvoye par API ni journalise, CDP DOM/Input sans Runtime.evaluate, cooldown 15 min apres echec, aucun Edge tue.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.4: Collecteur Live auto_capture actif par defaut, jours/plage persistants, creation quotidienne atomique via create_session/claim/lease et respect durable de l arret manuel jusqu au lendemain ou reactivation explicite.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.4: Edge et l onglet de supervision peuvent apparaitre apres le demarrage, disparaitre puis revenir; zero ou plusieurs onglets restent un etat d attente retryable 5-10 s et une session automatique ne reutilise jamais un target_id obsolette.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.4: Administration Collecteur Live expose un interrupteur Detection automatique, un bandeau En attente/Onglet detecte/Capture/Arret manuel, les jours actifs et horaires; Tester/Demarrer/Arreter restent des secours manuels.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.4 Live Native R10: Centre Qualite Live rend Qualite, alertes et fraicheur Hermes immediatement visibles, rail desktop >= 220 px repliable, etats par couleur+symbole, scrolls internes avec entetes collants, filtres et preferences memorises, mode mur d ecran optionnel.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.4 Live Native R10: Campagnes garde Traites/Abandonnes/QoS/Attente/En cours sans colonne Statut; jointure file renforcee par configuration, couples campagne+LineId observes et correspondance exacte InitQueue; Ready/Available sont desormais Disponibles.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.4: Agents affiche Appel total distinct de la duree d etat/HOLD, conserve Traites/Pauses/Deconnecte/ANI; Campagnes n est plus paginee et le responsive Agents/Campagnes/Double vue est coherent sous 900 px.
V60.5 ARCH RC29.4: gate final 296/296 tests passe, syntaxe Python/JavaScript verifiee; aucune base metier reinitialisee et aucune formule QoS/regle de signalisation modifiee.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.3 Live Native R9: scroll Agents corrige sur le vrai conteneur; compteurs files UpQuR/UpQuH recuperes sur toute la journee avec fenetre fraiche de 30 s pour le temps reel; diagnostic de couverture Hermes visible dans Campagnes.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.3 Live Native R7: vue Agents sans pagination avec tous les agents dans un scroll vertical interne, en-tete fixe; Campagnes expose Attente et En cours separement et conserve les files Hermes natives meme sans mapping campagne.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.3 Live Native R4: Campagnes/Perimetres masque les campagnes historiques sans file, conserve les compteurs journaliers Hermes UpQuH/UpAgtH entre reconnexions du meme jour et expose les files Hermes sans campagne mappee comme fallback diagnostique.
V60.5 ARCH RC29.3: Centre Qualite Live utilise un espace principal unique par defaut avec Agents en pleine largeur; Campagnes/Perimetres est une vue alternative et Double vue devient optionnelle.
V60.5 ARCH RC29.3: les KPI et le statut qualite sont regroupes dans un rail lateral compact; les details Qualite/Alertes/Limites sont regroupes derriere un seul tiroir Details.
V60.5 ARCH RC29.3: les actions secondaires Analyse/Regles sont rangees dans Plus afin de reduire le bruit visuel; recherche, groupe et changement de vue restent immediatement accessibles.
V60.5 ARCH RC29.3: la formule QoS RC29.1 et toutes les regles metier restent strictement inchangees.
V60.5 ARCH RC29.2: Centre Qualite Live is simplified into a cockpit layout with one compact toolbar, one KPI strip and the supervision panes immediately visible.
V60.5 ARCH RC29.2: supervisor can switch instantly between Agents, Double vue and Campagnes; selected layout persists in sessionStorage and does not trigger a route change or backend reload.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.2: desktop row density is increased, panel descriptions/counts are compacted, secondary quality/alerts/limits remain available as drawers, and the page itself stays fixed-height while lists scroll independently.
V60.5 ARCH RC29.2: RC29.1 canonical QoS formula and all previously validated business calculations remain unchanged.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.1: QoS unique = Traites / (Recus - Clotures - Raccroches avant file d attente) x 100 across Quality, Distributions, Pilotage and imported Live scope metrics; non-positive denominator remains unavailable.

V60.5 ARCH RC29.1: Centre Qualite Live desktop becomes a dense supervision workstation with Agents and Campaigns/Scopes side by side, sticky headers and independent panes so the operator no longer scrolls the whole page to switch between them.
V60.5 ARCH RC29.1: secondary Live quality, certified-history, alerts and limitations are collapsed into overlay drawers to preserve screen space; tablet/mobile keep the stacked responsive layout.
V60.5 ARCH RC29: release built from RC28 through the validated RC29 phased plan (identities, Live/DOM, signalling, distributions, global typed sorting, performance instrumentation).
V60.5 ARCH RC29: final production gate refreshes the release manifest only after regression, SQLite bootstrap, syntax and integrity checks; no business database migration is required.

V60.5 ARCH RC28: Centre Qualite Live uses configured groups/files as the supervision reference so all configured campaigns, queues and ACTIVE agents remain visible even when Hermes has not emitted a current state.

V60.5 ARCH RC28: configured agents without current Hermes state are shown as Non observe and are never silently converted to Deconnecte, Disponible or zero; coverage shows referenced versus observed agents.
V60.5 ARCH RC28: Qualite maintenant and Perimetres Qualite Live are moved to the top of the centre; unsupported Live waiting/QoS/abandon cards are removed instead of displaying Non disponible.

V60.5 ARCH RC28: waiting metrics that are semantically certified come from Stats.INBOUND in a separate Attente & qualite certifiees block; explicit HOLD remains only a per-call/agent detail and is not relabeled as queue waiting.
V60.5 ARCH RC28: campaigns are loaded with include_inactive=1 and the final agent section label is Etats Live des agents, with search across referenced agents/groups/states.

V60.5 ARCH RC27: fixes scope_query/scope_multi_query calls to use the keyword-only param='group' contract, removing the RC26 HTTP 400 failures in Quality/Analytics and HTTP 500 failures in Support/Details/Analytics.
V60.5 ARCH RC27: Signalisation Qualite Live supports true multi-target rules for GROUP, AGENT, CAMPAIGN, QUEUE and SERVICE while preserving legacy mono-target rules without a database schema change.

V60.5 ARCH RC27: Administration -> Signalisation Qualite Live is redesigned as a guided compact editor: one rule open at a time, target search/multi-selection, separated Conditions and Anti-bruit sections, and clearer status summaries.
V60.5 ARCH RC27: temporal fields and second-based metrics show grey examples such as 120 s = 2 min and 300 s = 5 min; percentage/count examples are also explicit.

V60.5 ARCH RC27: GROUP/AGENT/QUEUE targets are revalidated server-side against the authenticated user's business scope when a Live Quality rule is saved; UI filtering is not treated as a security boundary.

V60.5 ARCH RC26: Phase 15 enriches Centre Qualite Live with per-agent observed call counts for 15 minutes, 60 minutes and today, plus observed state-time breakdowns for call, explicit HOLD, ready, post-call, pause and offline.
V60.5 ARCH RC26: per-agent Temps non disponible observe is defined conservatively as Pause + Deconnecte + other unavailable states; Disponible and Post-appel are not counted as lost time.

V60.5 ARCH RC26: explicit Mise en attente / HOLD agent-state labels remain inside the same observed call segment and are exposed separately from generic Waiting/Disponible, which continues to mean agent availability.
V60.5 ARCH RC26: per-call hold duration is shown only when an explicit HOLD state exists in the Live timeline. Missing explicit evidence remains unavailable rather than becoming zero.
V60.5 ARCH RC26: campaign Live views add observed calls for 15 minutes, 60 minutes and today, while Stats.INBOUND/Stats.AGENT historical KPIs remain clearly separated and certified independently.
V60.5 ARCH RC26: queue waiting, P90 wait, Live QoS and per-call patient wait remain unavailable until Hermes semantics are certified; Phase 15 does not map undocumented arg_n counters.

V60.5 ARCH RC25: Phase 14 restructures Administration -> Utilisateurs & acces into Comptes, Groupes d acces, Profils and Droits effectifs tabs so the full security model is no longer displayed at once.

V60.5 ARCH RC25: access-group administration uses a compact list plus one selected editor; interface permissions are grouped by section in collapsible panels and business-scope groups are collapsed by default.
V60.5 ARCH RC25: accounts gain client-side search/status/access-group filters and explicit bulk assignment to an access group using the existing server membership API for every selected account.
V60.5 ARCH RC25: create-account, create-group and create-profile forms are collapsed by default; reusable profile actions are also folded into compact cards.
V60.5 ARCH RC25: a read-only Droits effectifs view shows the backend-computed interface permissions, ANI capability and business-group scope for one account before an administrator changes access.
V60.5 ARCH RC25: Phase 14 changes presentation and administration workflow only; RC23/RC24 server-side authorization, business-group scope enforcement and profile semantics remain authoritative.

V60.5 ARCH RC24: Phase 13 adds reusable access profiles in Administration -> Utilisateurs & acces. A profile snapshots every interface permission, ANI capability and business-group scope without containing users.

V60.5 ARCH RC24: an administrator can create a profile from an existing access group, duplicate a profile, refresh it from another access group, create a new access group from a profile, or explicitly apply it to an existing group.

V60.5 ARCH RC24: applying a profile replaces interface rights, ANI and business scope but preserves the target access-group name and memberships; affected sessions are invalidated so new rights take effect immediately.
V60.5 ARCH RC24: cloning an access group copies its security configuration but never copies members, preventing accidental privilege propagation.

V60.5 ARCH RC24: profiles referencing deleted business groups are rejected instead of silently widening the scope. PostgreSQL runtime preflight now explicitly checks the Phase 12/13 access-control tables.
V60.5 ARCH RC23: Phase 12 adds fine-grained access control for every Nelyio navigation interface with no access, read-only or read/write levels where applicable.

V60.5 ARCH RC23: security access groups are separated from business analysis groups; each access group can see all business groups or an explicit allowed list with a default group and an optional locked Group filter.
V60.5 ARCH RC23: Centre Qualite Live gains a server-enforced Groupe surveille selector; a locked scope cannot be bypassed by editing the URL and restricted users never fall back to all groups.

V60.5 ARCH RC23: Live campaigns, incidents, Live search and group-aware Quality/catalogue payloads are projected to the authenticated business scope; unavailable or cross-group aggregates are not silently relabeled.
V60.5 ARCH RC23: Priorites Support is isolated behind its own API/interface permission, so granting that screen no longer grants the broader Regles de classement interface.
V60.5 ARCH RC23: navigation and API authorization use the same interface permission model; users are redirected to the first interface they are actually allowed to open.

V60.5 ARCH RC22: Phase 11 adds an explainable read-only production performance analysis to Administration -> Sante de production, correlating sanitized Web slow paths, Analytics calculation kinds and the sustained-load report without claiming unproven causality.

V60.5 ARCH RC22: slow-log aggregation keeps the RC20/RC21 top_24h API contract unchanged while adding a separate detailed view with average, P95, maximum and accumulated slow-event time for targeted analysis.

V60.5 ARCH RC22: functional Web-to-Analytics mappings identify when both layers are slow on the same path; Web-only and Analytics-only evidence produce different next checks instead of blindly changing SQL or thresholds.

V60.5 ARCH RC22: ANALYSER_PERFORMANCE_PRODUCTION.bat generates logs/performance_analysis.md and JSON from existing technical evidence; the report is read-only and no recommendation is applied automatically.
V60.5 ARCH RC22: no business KPI, Live quality rule, PostgreSQL index, timeout or performance threshold is auto-tuned by Phase 11; insufficient evidence remains explicitly insufficient.

V60.5 ARCH RC21: Phase 10 removes the external requests runtime dependency; the only Edge DevTools JSON GET now uses Python urllib, so the Requests security/version warning disappears by reducing the dependency surface rather than upgrading an otherwise unnecessary package.

V60.5 ARCH RC21: Web slow logging threshold is configurable with NELYIO_HTTP_SLOW_SECONDS; Analytics keeps NELYIO_ANALYTICS_SLOW_SECONDS. Production Health exposes the effective thresholds without changing any business KPI.

V60.5 ARCH RC21: observability warning/critical thresholds are configurable with NELYIO_OBS_SLOW_EVENTS_PER_HOUR, NELYIO_OBS_CRITICAL_SLOW_EVENTS_PER_HOUR and NELYIO_OBS_CRITICAL_SLOW_SECONDS; severe sustained latency can explicitly mark the technical state DEGRADE.

V60.5 ARCH RC21: TEST_CHARGE_PROLONGEE.bat adds a read-only sustained-load proof with five independent authenticated sessions by default, before/after health checks, bounded aggregate endpoints and a JSON report under logs.

V60.5 ARCH RC21: Administration -> Sante de production displays the latest sustained-load result and its P95; the dashboard remains read-only and does not expose business identifiers, query strings or credentials.
V60.5 ARCH RC21: visible application branding is realigned to RC21 so the browser title/sidebar no longer lag behind the installed VERSION.json.

V60.5 ARCH RC20: Phase 9 adds Administration -> Sante de production, a read-only observability view for Web/Live/Analytics/PostgreSQL, Live freshness, authenticated session counts, importer mode, last production recipe and bounded slow logs.
V60.5 ARCH RC20: observability never exposes ANI, patient identifiers, query strings or credentials; slow HTTP entries are aggregated by path only and Analytics entries by calculation kind.
V60.5 ARCH RC20: the production health endpoint is protected by Config read permission and uses a shared 5-second server cache so multiple administrator tabs do not multiply PostgreSQL/health probes.
V60.5 ARCH RC20: the UI refreshes every 10 seconds with a single cancellable loop; manual refresh cannot create parallel polling loops.
V60.5 ARCH RC20: inactive Live outside a running session is not treated as a service-quality failure; an active but stale Live session is explicitly A_SURVEILLER.
V60.5 ARCH RC20: reading the production health view does not create import folders or initialize the service-heartbeat database; existing technical state is consumed read-only.
V60.5 ARCH RC19: Phase 8 adds a consolidated production acceptance runner with PASS/WARN/FAIL/SKIP evidence and no business-data mutation.

V60.5 ARCH RC19: the recipe checks static integrity, PostgreSQL without repair, internal health/build/services, HTTPS/TLS, authenticated Live/Campaigns/Groups/Quality APIs, group assignment source, Live freshness and five independent authenticated sessions.
V60.5 ARCH RC19: reports are written only to logs as JSON/Markdown; credentials are never serialized and the PowerShell wrapper clears the process password environment after execution.
V60.5 ARCH RC19: missing data, stale Hermes or skipped authenticated checks can never produce GO; cross-LAN HTTPS remains an external proof when the recipe is executed on the server itself.
V60.5 ARCH RC18: Analytiques gains a new Synthese Analytiques home organized as Signal -> Explication -> Perimetre -> Preuves -> Drilldown -> Action.
V60.5 ARCH RC18: the summary reuses only /api/quality/pilotage for facts, baselines, signals, files, reliability and actions; no duplicate KPI engine or heavy endpoint is introduced.
V60.5 ARCH RC18: the landing page is intentionally bounded to four reference KPIs and at most five explainable signals; detailed views remain specialized drilldowns.
V60.5 ARCH RC18: hypotheses remain verification paths, never asserted causes; files remain ODCalls.FirstQueue drilldown and official QoS remains Stats.INBOUND.
V60.5 ARCH RC18: actions can be created directly from the selected analytical signal while before/after causal safeguards remain those of the existing Quality action engine.

V60.5 ARCH RC17: Phase 6 adds the human incident lifecycle NOUVEAU -> VU -> EN_INVESTIGATION -> ACTION_EN_COURS while automatic rule recovery remains authoritative for RETABLI; CLOTURE is allowed only after recovery.

V60.5 ARCH RC17: each lifecycle change, comment and action is stored in the existing Nelyio_Live.db as a durable incident event with actor, timestamp and optional snapshot; no new database is introduced.
V60.5 ARCH RC17: ACTION_EN_COURS requires an explicit action description. The action snapshot is compared with the later automatic recovery snapshot to show before/after observations.
V60.5 ARCH RC17: the comparison wording is explicitly non-causal: Amelioration observee apres l action does not claim that the action caused the improvement.

V60.5 ARCH RC17: new LIVE Incidents / Alertes workspace separates active incidents from history, exposes lifecycle, reasons, comments, action and before/after evidence, and respects collection read/write permissions.
V60.5 ARCH RC17: active incidents cannot be manually hidden by closing them; the signal must first return to normal according to the configured Live Quality rule.
V60.5 ARCH RC17: synthetic SQLite benchmark with 200 incidents and 5 events each: detail median ~0.46 ms / P95 ~0.62 ms; list 200 median ~2.40 ms / P95 ~2.71 ms.
V60.5 ARCH RC16: Phase 5 adds one bounded campaign drilldown payload: Campaign -> Queue -> ACTIVE/observed agents -> recent observed Live calls -> factual timeline/diagnostic.
V60.5 ARCH RC16: visible Live terminology is standardized in French: wrap-up / wrap / Post-travail are displayed as Post-appel; internal wrap/wrap_up keys remain unchanged for compatibility.

V60.5 ARCH RC16: queue drilldown preserves missing historical metrics as unavailable instead of zero; ACTIVE agents absent from the current Hermes snapshot are displayed as Non observe rather than falsely disconnected.
V60.5 ARCH RC16: Stats.AGENT handled/conversation/HOLD context is aggregated in one batch for involved agents; no SELECT loop per queue or agent is introduced.
V60.5 ARCH RC16: recent Live call preview is bounded, permissions-aware and observational only; ANI remains masked without permission and timeline contains only events actually captured.
V60.5 ARCH RC16: Appels suspects accepts campaign/queue/agent/date deep-link filters from the drilldown without creating a parallel search engine.
V60.5 ARCH RC16: synthetic payload benchmark with 114 agents, 20 queues and 100 calls: median ~0.97 ms, P95 ~1.09 ms for in-memory drilldown composition.
V60.5 ARCH RC15: nouvelle vue Live Campagnes a surveiller avec contrat backend unique et fenetres live_now / last_15m / today / reference explicitement separees.
V60.5 ARCH RC15: Maintenant vient de Hermes Live; 15 min/Aujourd hui/Reference viennent de Stats.INBOUND importe et restent etiquetes comme historiques, jamais comme temps reel Hermes.
V60.5 ARCH RC15: concentration par file derivee de ODCalls.FirstQueue avec part de campagne, agents ACTIVE/connectes/disponibles et statut Qualite Live; cas 72 pour cent couvert par test.
V60.5 ARCH RC15: Campagne reste distincte de Groupe; groupes/services sont resolus depuis les files configurees et agents ACTIVE, un agent multi-files etant compte une seule fois.

V60.5 ARCH RC15: waiting_now, oldest waiting et P90/mediane attente reellement Live restent non disponibles tant que la semantique Hermes n est pas certifiee; aucune absence de donnee ne devient zero.
V60.5 ARCH RC15: /api/live/campaigns utilise des aggregations batch et un plan historique borne independant du nombre de campagnes; aucun SELECT par campagne/file/agent.
V60.5 ARCH RC15: une panne Analytics/PostgreSQL ne fait plus tomber la vue Campagnes Live; le Live continue et les fenetres historiques passent explicitement en analytics_unavailable.
V60.5 ARCH RC15: benchmark synthetique 12 000 appels/jour x 5 jours, 30 campagnes: mediane ~0,35 s et P95 ~0,37 s sur SQLite isole.
V60.5 ARCH RC14: Supervision Live devient Centre Qualite Live; le premier ecran privilegie qualite, signaux, preuves et perimetres plutot qu une simple liste d agents.
V60.5 ARCH RC14: aucun faux vert: collecte perimee/interrompue, moteur de signalisation indisponible ou absence totale de regles actives produisent un etat explicite non NORMAL.
V60.5 ARCH RC14: le cockpit expose incidents actifs avec raisons/valeurs/seuils, duree et couleur configuree; Service/Groupe/Campagne/File restent des dimensions distinctes et filtrables.
V60.5 ARCH RC14: le bloc Qualite maintenant affiche les metriques Live prouvees; waiting_now, P90/mediane attente, abandon et QoS Live restent Non disponible tant que Hermes n est pas certifie.

V60.5 ARCH RC14: contexte Stats.INBOUND du jour reutilise le Pilotage Qualite existant, charge separement du Live et cache cote client 60 s / Analytics 120 s; il est clairement presente comme importe et non instantane.
V60.5 ARCH RC14: preuves agents repliees par defaut; liens de recherche Live acceptent maintenant campagne/file/agent dans le hash sans recreer un moteur de recherche.
V60.5 ARCH RC14: centre calcule en batch depuis un snapshot deja charge, sans SELECT par campagne/file/agent; benchmark synthetique 114 agents, 30 campagnes, 60 files: mediane ~2.8 ms, P95 ~3.0 ms.
V60.5 ARCH RC13: moteur Qualité Live central exécuté par le worker Live toutes les 5 s; aucun navigateur ne crée ses propres alertes ou incidents.

V60.5 ARCH RC13: niveaux, libellés, rangs et couleurs configurables; règles par GLOBAL/SERVICE/GROUP/CAMPAIGN/QUEUE/AGENT avec conditions ET/OU, durée minimale, retour normal, cooldown et volume minimum.
V60.5 ARCH RC13: métriques Live normalisées avec source/qualité; une donnée indisponible ou périmée n est jamais convertie en zéro et ne peut pas déclarer automatiquement un incident rétabli.
V60.5 ARCH RC13: incidents persistants dans Nelyio_Live.db avec anti-bruit durable; une règle + un périmètre ne produit qu un incident actif, puis RETABLI après hystérésis et cooldown.
V60.5 ARCH RC13: Administration ajoute Signalisation Qualité Live; l administrateur peut configurer couleurs/règles sans modifier Python et la configuration est incluse dans export/import global.
V60.5 ARCH RC13: waiting_now, oldest_waiting, médiane/P90 attente, abandon et QoS Live restent explicitement non certifiés tant que les compteurs Hermes UpQuR/UpQuCB/UpQuMR/UpCaR ne sont pas prouvés.
V60.5 ARCH RC12: les tailles WAV RC4-RC11 sont invalidées une fois; aucune ancienne valeur non vérifiée n'est promue automatiquement dans Appels suspects.
V60.5 ARCH RC12: avant stockage, chaque WAV doit correspondre à un appel SIMPLIFY2 unique avec même Indice, même journée de référence, Conversation > 0 et agent cohérent; sinon le Size est rejeté.
V60.5 ARCH RC12: Appels suspects n'affiche la taille WAV que lorsqu'elle est vérifiée; les appels Conversation=0 n'exposent plus de pseudo-WAV ni de densité média.
V60.5 ARCH RC12: l'Indice est affiché directement dans la ligne Appels suspects pour permettre une vérification manuelle immédiate dans Hermes Enregistrements.
V60.5 ARCH RC12: le contrat persistant reste strictement call_recording_sizes(indice,size_bytes); date, agent, filename et chemin servent uniquement à la validation transitoire puis sont jetés.

V60.5 ARCH RC11: Appels suspects ne calcule plus la densite Size lorsque ConvDuration=0; aucun fallback sur CallDuration. Les appels sans conversation sont non analysables par Size et ne sont pas signales sur ce motif.

V60.5 ARCH RC10: SYNC_RECORDING_SIZES defaults to TOUT history; Nelyio discovers every available year/month/day under every SDA/campaign root and resumes completed historical days instead of limiting synchronization to one day or 31-day windows.

V60.5 ARCH RC10: active recording metadata contract is reduced to call_recording_sizes(indice,size_bytes); filename, agent, date/time, path and SDA/campaign are transient crawl data and are not persisted.
V60.5 ARCH RC10: multiple WAV pieces sharing the same Indice are deduplicated by filename in memory and their Size values are summed before one Indice row is stored; Indice 0 is ignored.
V60.5 ARCH RC10: RC4-RC9 call_recordings data is migrated once by Indice aggregation for backward compatibility; new synchronization writes only the simplified table.
V60.5 ARCH RC10: Appels suspects reads only the simplified Indice->Size table for media density; transfer/consultation/rerouting and in-call hold exclusions remain unchanged.

V60.5 ARCH RC9: recording-size sync now follows the real Hermes hierarchy SDA/campaign -> year -> month -> day -> agent/login -> WAV; the misleading instruction to click a folder named by the full date is removed.

V60.5 ARCH RC9: a RECORD folder_info request at root level (subPath empty) is accepted as the authenticated session seed, so simply opening Enregistrements is enough; Nelyio then builds the requested date path under every detected SDA/campaign automatically.
V60.5 ARCH RC9: SYNC_RECORDING_SIZES.bat asks the operator to remain at the SDA/campaign level; no manual navigation into year, month, day, agent or WAV folders is required.

V60.5 ARCH RC8: recording-size synchronization discovers all top-level RECORD clinic roots visible in Hermes (for example 76430929 - CH GISORS, 76431213 - CIMVES-HABERGES) instead of treating the clicked clinic root as the whole recording store.

V60.5 ARCH RC8: one real click on the requested day remains the session anchor, then every detected root is scanned automatically as root -> year -> month -> day -> agent -> WAV; no per-clinic, per-agent or per-WAV click is required.

V60.5 ARCH RC8: sync output now reports RECORD roots detected, roots containing WAV, agent folders traversed and total WAV files; the old agents-probed counter is no longer presented as if it represented all traversed agent folders.

V60.5 ARCH RC7: recording-size sync waits for one real click on the requested day (year -> month -> day), captures that exact folder_info request/response through CDP, and uses the returned FolderList as the authoritative day root before automatic agent/WAV crawling.

V60.5 ARCH RC7: child folder_info requests reuse the captured query template and GetChanges referrer instead of rebuilding a generic POST; sync output reports agent folders seen in the real day response for completeness diagnostics.
V60.5 ARCH RC6: recording-size synchronization recursively walks every folder returned by Hermes with loop/depth/request guards; no manual agent-folder opening is required.
